1/ On July 2nd, @vechainofficial launched its long-anticipated StarGate staking program. This marked a major milestone in the #VeChain Renaissance roadmap, introducing protocol-level staking, NFT-based participation, and regulatory alignment. Here’s what happened: 2/ What is StarGate staking? StarGate introduced a new on-chain staking model where users stake $VET directly through the VeChainThor blockchain. Participation is represented by NFTs, making the process transparent and verifiable on-chain. 3/ Regulatory clarity set the stage The launch came shortly after the SEC clarified that protocol staking does not constitute a securities offering. VeChain’s model aligned with this, framing rewards as compensation for providing network services, not investment returns. 4/ Designed for both institutional and retail participants With staking ETFs expected by late 2025 and growing institutional interest in crypto, VeChain's model appealed to both large-scale and individual participants. NFT-based staking simplified tracking, compliance, and custody requirements. 5/ Part of the VeChain Renaissance upgrade StarGate was a core component of the broader VeChain Renaissance, the most significant protocol upgrade in the network’s history. Key improvements included EVM equivalence, JSON RPC support, upgraded tokenomics, and a new consensus model. 6/ A new staking model with low entry barriers The Weighted Delegated Proof of Stake (wDPoS) model opened staking to anyone with 10,000 VET. This represented a major shift toward decentralization. Staking tiers were introduced, starting at 10,000 VET and scaling up to Mjolnir X at 15.6 million VET. 7/ $15 million in rewards to boost adoption To incentivize early participation, the VeChain Foundation committed 5.48 billion VTHO, valued at approximately $15 million, to enhance APYs over the first six months of the program. Node operators who migrated early received even higher yields. 8/ Tools for estimating rewards Participants were encouraged to use the VeChainStats $VTHO Estimator and Redeno Staking Simulator to calculate potential APYs and select the most suitable tier for their holdings. 9/ Self-custody was required Only VET held in self-custody wallets such as VeWorld was eligible for staking. Participants needed to transfer tokens off centralized exchanges to receive the staking NFT required to activate rewards. 10/ Why this launch matters StarGate combined regulatory compliance, ease of access, #NFT technology, and strong financial incentives into a single staking platform.
